t: You're looking at the Chapel Royal of St Peter ad Vincula, the former parish church of the Tower of London, in the Inner Ward. The current building dates from 1520, though a church was likely here in the twelfth century. It is named for Saint Peter's imprisonment. Many people who fell from power are buried here. Thomas More is buried here, the author of Utopia. So are two of Henry the Eighth's queens, Anne Boleyn and Catherine Howard. Lady Jane Grey, the Nine Days Queen, lies here too. So does Thomas Cromwell, Henry's chief minister, who was beheaded on the king's orders.
